text:
Alex: quick heads-up — I published @redwood-inference/sdk v1.16.0 with a simplified exports map and now the cloudflare wrangler sample errors: "The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk' does not provide an export named 'default'"

Priya: yikes. can you paste the package.json snippet?

Alex: sure:
```json
{"exports":"./dist/index.esm.js","main":"./dist/index.cjs.js","module":"./dist/index.esm.js"}
```

Jordan: that's the problem — a string exports value makes the package ESM-only for conditional-resolvers and hides the CJS require entry. Also if our ESM build uses named exports, `import sdk from` will fail in runtimes expecting a default.

CI Bot: release pipeline caught failing sample: Error: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk' does not provide an export named 'default'

Priya: short-term options: 1) revert publish and cut patch, 2) add a compatibility ESM entry that exports default, or 3) make exports conditional with import/require. Revert is fastest.

Alex: will revert and cut 1.16.1, then follow up with: add CI smoke tests (Node + Miniflare + Deno) and a compat build that guarantees a default export. Opening an issue now and tagging @Jordan.

Jordan: sg. also add a tiny samples/README and checklist item: "run samples in Wrangler/Miniflare and Node before changing package entry points."

Alex: rollback published, CI green. Thanks everyone.
